claims.text: Meta launched a native Meta AI desktop app for Mac, in addition to the existing meta.ai web version and mobile app
claims.reasoning: Confirmed directly against Meta's own post on its official Meta for Business newsroom (facebook.com/business/news), dated 19 August 2026: 'the new Meta AI desktop app' / 'the new Mac app', explicitly listed alongside meta.ai and the mobile app. This is an unregistered-but-Tier-0-qualifying source (Meta's own company channel, not a third party) per verification.md §1 -- flagged in the cycle report for registration consideration, not yet added to sources.yaml (policy files are off-limits this run).

claims.text: The Mac app supports screen sharing during a session and system-wide dictation across all Mac apps
claims.reasoning: Meta's own post states verbatim: 'With the new Mac app, you can share a window during a session to show what you're working on, and it responds with tailored advice to the work in front of you' and 'You can also use built-in dictation that works across all apps on your Mac.'

claims.text: Meta AI can now connect directly to a user's Instagram and Facebook accounts for engagement analytics, to Meta ad-campaign performance data, and to Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides)
claims.reasoning: Meta's own post confirms all three connector categories: Instagram/Facebook account engagement analytics, Meta ad-campaign performance/optimization insights, and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides) integration -- framed as business-focused features aimed at small businesses.

falsifier_notes: Cycle 4 of 2026-08-20's adversarial falsifier attempted to break the story on two fronts: (1) whether the ~8 outlets corroborating within hours of each other reflected genuine independent reporting or a shared press briefing/embargo (concluded: likely a shared briefing given near-identical specific details, so outlet count alone was NOT treated as satisfying independence -- moot now that a Tier-0 primary is in hand, since announcement claims need only one primary per verification.md §3); (2) searched for any denial, correction, or scope walk-back (found none, story was very fresh at the time). Neither front broke the claim set.
